stem: A required environmental check was missed for part of a production interval. What is the best first quality-system response?
choices: Backfill a normal value without noting the gap
Document the deviation, establish affected time/material scope, assess impact using available evidence, and preserve the missing-data condition
Close the issue because no plant symptoms are visible
rationale: A deviation system should preserve the factual record, determine scope and assess impact rather than manufacture evidence or assume no consequence from absence of visible symptoms.
